assets.facts/air.webp: Vertical 4:5 editorial conservation photo illustration of Indonesian peat restoration. At upper center a tangible splash of clear water entering a shallow rewetting channel among dark saturated peat, wet peat fibers and tiny roots visible in a cross section at the channel edge, jade reflections. Strong one-subject composition, realistic wet textures, glint of cool daylight, foreground upper half sharply in focus, lower half gently darkening into nearly black water, little detail in bottom half so a designer can place readable white text there later. Water and saturated soil should be obvious at thumbnail size. Muted cinematic grading. No text, labels, letters, watermark, flames, or branding.
assets.facts/bara.webp: Vertical 4:5 environmental editorial concept photo illustration for a fire education campaign. A dramatic close view of cross-section of dry fibrous Indonesian peat, sparse singed roots at surface, deep crack just below the surface containing a vivid cluster of glowing orange and red embers, wisps of light smoke drifting upward. No flames above the ground. Object and red light concentrated in the upper to middle part. Lower third trails off into very dark texture with ample blank room for legible text overlay added later. Restrained charcoal and warm vermilion palette, physically plausible textures, beautiful detail, no people, no labels, no lettering, no logos.
assets.facts/hotspot.webp: Vertical 4:5 visual for an Indonesian educational card about reading satellite heat detections. Stylish editorial satellite view of part of central Kalimantan, unmistakable aerial river delta curves and forestry texture with a few small amber infrared detection marks and fine subtle coordinate grid. Artistic illustration only, not based on a real active incident. The aerial river and sparse infrared points are strong in upper half, lower half rolls into deep petrol blue and charcoal with space for text overlay to be added later. No decorative HUD, no pseudo text, no legend, no numbers, no border, no logos. Rich photographic geographic texture.
assets.keeper/kanopi.webp: Wide landscape 1.90:1 panoramic premium nature photography for a personalized Indonesian campaign participation card. Bird’s-eye drone view over a continuous Borneo rainforest canopy after rain, undulating textured emerald tree crowns, pale mist over far right, sweeping low golden shafts through gaps at the upper right, deepest dark green on left half with low detail for a white name overlay added by a developer. Main visual can also crop centrally to portrait. Dark emerald and olive, sweeping scale, organic documentary realism. No text, no numbers, no labels, no border, no logos or UI.
assets.keeper/arus.webp: Wide 1.90:1 modern editorial photographic image for a personalized conservation card. A deep dark tea-water river threading sinuously through Indonesian peatlands, oblique aerial perspective. The blue-cyan river glints under moonlike blue-hour light on center-right, dusky blue and teal surrounding woods, deep nearly black shadows on the left for future text. Vivid water course subject, graceful winding shape, soft long exposure and restrained glossy color, different from a forest canopy image. No text, no border, no typography, no branding, no humans.
assets.keeper/serat.webp: Wide 1.90:1 extreme macro museum photography for a premium Indonesian conservation field card. Beautiful natural layered peat fibers and interlaced roots with tiny amber moisture beads, charcoal brown with warm copper highlights, distinctive diagonal organic grain and embossed earthy texture. Main root tangle on the right middle; dark low-detail shadows on the left. Natural scientific specimen photography with tactile side light, no flame, no dust effects, no text, no border, no labels or logos.
assets.keeper/fajar.webp: Wide landscape 1.90:1 cinematic conservation photography, ground-level Indonesian tropical wetland at dawn, silhouette of one Bornean rhinoceros hornbill in flight against peach and lavender sky rising over distant layers of mountain ridges and a calm flooded meadow. Bird near upper right-middle and captured naturally at a distance, dark foreground on left for name typography added later. Expansive negative space and subtle plum-rose light, distinct from dense jungle visuals. No text, no numbers, no border or logos.
assets.keeper/rintik.webp: Wide 1.90:1 ultra-detailed wet forest macro nature photograph for a premium Indonesian environmental card. A single fresh deep green broad native understory leaf, seen from low grazing angle, with three large beautiful round clear rain droplets reflecting forest light and finely visible leaf veins. Leaf mostly right and middle, falling away to dark defocused green-black on left for type later. Silver specular highlights and emerald hues, naturally asymmetrical diagonal composition, no collage, text, border, icons or logos.
